text:
maria.g: vendor-ops flagged that our RMA shipment for the H100 top-off was split into two AWBs (courier + freight). vendor says they shipped replacement units in AWB1 and the defective returns in AWB2. Need confirmation on insurance declared value, ASN/serial mapping, and whether warehouse will accept split deliveries. :eyes:

vendor-ops: AWB1: 123-45678901 (courier, 2 boxes, declared $220k)
AWB2: 987-65432100 (freight, pallet, declared $0 for return)
Carrier notes: courier ETA 48h to SFO, freight ETA 6 business days to Oakland crossdock.
We attached the provisional ASN with serial-to-AWB mapping.

devin.t: please drop the PO and RMA IDs here so we can reconcile in procurement. also, which SKUs on AWB1 are replacements vs loaners?

maria.g: PO 45001234, RMA RMA-2026-778. AWB1 contains replacements: 2x H100-80GB (S/Ns: H100-001234, H100-001235). AWB2 has returns: 2x defective H100 (S/Ns: H100-000987, H100-000988).

ashley.w: quick customs check — freight leg will hit the Oakland depot with a pallet. Need HS code and commercial invoice even if declared value 0. For returns, we usually flag "return for credit" and include original invoice ref. Carrier needs that to avoid duties.

vendor-ops: noted. HS code we'll use 847330 (computer parts), commercial invoice attached, reason: RMA/repair. We can mark AWB2 as "return" and AWB1 as "sale".

kevin.l: warehouse ops — can our SFO dock take the courier boxes outside normal receiving window? courier ETA is Tue 10am-2pm. Also need pallet label template for the freight.

maria.g: we can accept courier between 9-3 but need the ASN ahead of arrival. vendor-ops, please post the ASN CSV (one row per serial) in channel. For the freight, please confirm pallet dimensions and whether pallets are shrinkwrapped.

vendor-ops: attaching ASN snippet: 
```
AWB,SKU,SERIAL,TYPE
123-45678901,H100-80GB,H100-001234,REPLACEMENT
123-45678901,H100-80GB,H100-001235,REPLACEMENT
987-65432100,H100-000987,RETURN
987-65432100,H100-000988,RETURN
```
Pallet dims: 48x40x60, weight 420kg, shrinkwrapped, labels on two sides.

ops-bot: Automated note — shipping SLA breach window approaching if freight not cleared customs within 72h of arrival. Escalation trigger set for devops-oncall if delay exceeds 96h.

devin.t: for invoicing — vendor agreed to net out replacement cost vs credit for returns. Need vendor confirmation on final invoice split and insurance claim procedure if DOA on the return side. vendor-ops please confirm carrier insurance contacts and claim lead time.

vendor-ops: Carrier insurance (courier): CourierInsure Ltd, claim contact claims@courierinsure.example, claim window 30 days. Freight insurance via ForwardSafe, claims@forwardsafe.example, 45 days. We'll request consolidation of single invoice showing charge for AWB1 and credit memo for AWB2.

ashley.w: remember we require serial-level RMA acknowledgement before releasing replacements to product teams. Once courier is scanned into SFO, ops will verify serials and then we can release. For freight returns, we need photos of packaging and DOA report prior to issuing credit.

kevin.l: SFO will confirm receipt and send a photo of boxes + invoice scan. Oakland crossdock to receive pallet, will hold until customs paperwork is complete, then route to returns depot.

maria.g: thanks. Action items: vendor-ops to post full ASN file and invoice draft (today EOD), vendor to confirm insurance contacts (done), warehouse to confirm receipt windows (kevin noted), procurement (devin) to expect consolidated invoice and run P&L hold until credit posted. If everyone OK, we'll mark this thread as resolved when ASN + invoice posted. :thumbsup:

vendor-ops: ASN and provisional invoice uploaded to the shared drive: https://files.example.com/rma/2345678901/asn_invoice_draft.pdf. Will update when AWB scans come in.

maria.g: confirmed receipt of docs. marking pending until SFO scan.

kevin.l: will post scan + photo in this thread once courier delivered.

devin.t: will hold payment until credit is reflected or until procurement okays split invoice.

vendor-ops: thanks all. We'll keep the channel updated. :shipit:
